verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents registrable outbound HTTP webhooks for Jira. The pack covers REST APIs, an OpenAPI spec, automation and Slack and marketplace integrations, but none of these is a documented event-subscription webhook, and chat-app integrations do not qualify. Webhooks are a fair axis for a work-tracking SaaS, so the absence of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
